general_information.Description: This course provides students with fundamental knowledge of human body structure and proportions, as well as skills in drawing and sketching human figures. It is a foundational course for quick sketching and animation design. The course is offered in conjunction with Coursera's "Anatomy for the Character Design Artist". Throughout the course, students will learn about the history of anatomy, study the structure of the human body in motion, and learn how to draw the proportions of the head, shoulders and arms, legs and feet, and torso. Students will then apply these skills to practice drawing humans in various poses. Finally, students will be able to create character designs that maintain harmonious and visually pleasing human anatomy proportions. In addition, students will be introduced to the use of AI tools in supporting reference generation, pose exploration, and character design ideation, helping them enhance their visual outcomes while still maintaining core anatomy principles.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook and references in advance - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course.
general_information.Tools: Students should prepare: - Graphite pencil or Charcoal pencil. - Drawing tube. - Eraser - Pins, A3 artboard - A3, A4 size drawing paper - Knife - Laptop with PS/ Adobe Illuatrator

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Remember and understand the brief history of Anatomy
Memorize the structure of the Human Body and know how to draw the proportion of The Head, The Shoulder and Arm, The Leg and Feet, The Torso
Apply the knowledge that learned from The Human Portrait Practice to creat the human portrait and the facial expressions

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Knowledges on main-text, Slide, Teacher's Resource, Coursera. Module 1
assessments.Grading Guide: Experiential method 1: Students take multiple-choice tests based on the suggested multiple-choice questions of Module 1 on Coursera.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Knowledges on main-text, Slide, Teacher's Resource, Coursera. Module 2
assessments.Grading Guide: Students practices drawing. Lecturer evaluates and grades the student's drawings. Scoring scale (10 points): Built up: create overall ratio of the object accurately. Ratio of every single object, part must be match with overall layout. Build up object's structure correctly without distortion. Draw bones and muscles structure correctly. (4 points); Block and planes: create accurately fragments in accordance to the structure, suitable and appropriate values. (2 points); Demonstration: demonstrate values correctly in accordance to real space of objects, hence enable virtual space upon drawings. Though such demonstration, material and shade of objects are presented. (1 point); Technique: clear outline, good dark-bright and bold-light contrast, describe properties of objects (1 point); Emphasis: emphasis object's details reasonably (1 point); Emotion: the drawing demonstrates feelings and aesthetic (0.5 - 1.0 point). AI usage guideline (optional and supportive): After completing the core hand-drawing assignment, students may optionally use AI tools in the post-production stage to support presentation of their work. This can include: Creating simple animated movements or transitions using AI animation tools (e.g., AnimateDiff, Runway, etc.); Enhancing the drawn figures with pose exploration previews to compare anatomy proportions; Supporting visual presentation (e.g., layout suggestion, color contrast preview) without altering the hand-drawn structure. Note: The original hand-drawn artwork remains the primary product for evaluation. If AI tools are applied in the post-processing phase, students must submit an additional 1-page report (in PDF) detailing the tools used, specific steps taken, and purpose of enhancement, along with the final product. This report will be reviewed for transparency and will not affect the drawing score but may contribute to a bonus if well documented and appropriately applied.
assessments.Note: Submit 03 hand-drawn papers. Submit hard copy in class. Submit soft copy to Coursera and instructor's drive link

There are full bodies, portraits, busts, close-up features... There are accompanying landscapes, but the scenes are only secondary in the story. Implementation: Draw with software or draw by hand, draw in color or draw in black and white... Draw carefully
